subject: Critical Thinking
title: Nassim Taleb: Black Swans and the Limits of Prediction
description: A quick win: understand Nassim Taleb: Black Swans and the Limits of Prediction.

hook.text: Before 1697, Europeans believed all swans were white. Then they reached Australia.

buildup.text: Nassim Taleb sets up the core claim, the assumptions, and the stakes.

discovery.text: 9/11, the 2008 financial crisis, COVID-19 – all Black Swans.

twist.text: Nassim Taleb has a twist: the obvious interpretation usually breaks down.

climax.text: Nassim Taleb matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: You can't predict the unpredictable. But you can prepare to benefit from it.

quiz.question: What is a 'Black Swan' according to Taleb?
options: A rare, unpredictable event with massive impact that is retrospectively rationalized
